title: Which Plan Premium Charges Are Reckoned on a Ridgecrest Advantage Premium Account
content:
The plan premium reckoned on the premium account of a Ridgecrest Advantage Medicare Advantage Health Plan enrollment is taken from the plan premium charges standing on that account, and which of them are taken depends on the billing cadence of the enrollment and on how many such charges stand there.

**Where the enrollment is billed quarterly and at least 2 plan premium charges stand on the premium account**, the plan premium reckoned on the account is every plan premium charge posted on it in the contract year.

**Where the enrollment is billed monthly and at least 2 plan premium charges stand on the premium account**, the plan premium reckoned on the account is the plan premium charges posted on it in the last 3 months.

**Where fewer than 2 plan premium charges stand on the premium account**, the plan premium reckoned on the account is the most recent plan premium charge standing on it.

### Basis questions

**An enrollment billed quarterly carries 1 plan premium charge.** Fewer than 2 charges stand on the account, so the cadence does not come into it: the plan premium reckoned is that single most recent charge.

**An enrollment billed monthly carries 5 plan premium charges, of which 2 were posted in the last 3 months.** At least 2 charges stand on the account and the cadence is monthly, so the plan premium reckoned is the charges posted in the last 3 months, which is those 2; the older 3 are not reckoned.

**An enrollment billed quarterly carries 3 plan premium charges, all posted in the contract year.** At least 2 charges stand on the account and the cadence is quarterly, so the plan premium reckoned is every one of those 3 charges, whenever in the contract year each was posted.
